description: Search all loaded regulation modules in one call, ranked by relevance across them. Use when the question names more than one act or you do not know which act holds the answer. limit, detail (compact|full) and max_chars bound the response; per_regulation_min gives each act a share of the page. Each hit carries its regulation id — then read_unit per regulation.

as_of.description: Optional date YYYY-MM-DD: answer with the wording in force on that date (default today). Amended provisions say which act gave them their wording
as_of.title: As Of

detail.description: compact (default: ~400-char excerpt around the match) | full (whole unit text)
detail.title: Detail

kinds.description: Optional filter: recital, article, paragraph, annex, section
kinds.title: Kinds

limit.description: Most rows to return (default 10 on searches, max 50)
limit.title: Limit

max_chars.description: Cap on the response size in characters (default 8000)
max_chars.title: Max Chars

per_regulation_min.description: Optional: at least this many rows from each act with matches
per_regulation_min.title: Per Regulation Min

regulations.description: Optional subset of regulation ids; default = all loaded corpus
regulations.title: Regulations

name: search_regulations
title: Search all regulations
